headline: Operations Leader, Systems & Process Building
profile: Operations leader with 15 years' experience building teams, processes and systems from the ground up, most recently as Head of Esports Operations at BLAST. Rebuilt the department's structure and documentation, wrote the business case for a new OPEX budget, and designed and built in-house tools, using Claude Code, covering tournament operations, freelancer bookings, travel and budgets, as well as scoping an early AI vision prototype for event-day tracking. Delivered 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries, working across product, commercial and finance stakeholders to align budgets and pitch new work. Outside work, built "Agent Office", an AI-driven job-search system, also using Claude Code. Comfortable building trust quickly and getting new processes adopted in a fast-moving team.

jobs.title: Head of Esports Operations
bullets: Designed and built the department's Esports Ops Suite using Claude Code: AI-built tools for tournament operations, freelancer staffing, travel bookings and event budgets, replacing manual spreadsheets
Scoped an AI vision system to automate player tracking at a major tournament: a full planning document, mockups and an early working prototype, covering method, privacy, rollout and risk
Rebuilt how the department works, with clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation
Wrote the business case for a departmental OPEX budget covering equipment renewal, software and cross-event costs
Costed and pitched new tournament work with the product and commercial teams
Held fortnightly meetings with the finance team to align departmental budgets
Led a six-person department running tournament operations across every BLAST ecosystem, including CS2, Dota 2, Brawl Stars, Fortnite, Rocket League and Rainbow Six

jobs.title: Tournament Operations Manager
bullets: Managed tournament equipment and staffing budgets across CS:GO, Dota 2, Apex Legends, FIFA, Fortnite and Rainbow Six
Booked and managed tournament operations freelancers for internal, external and online productions
Approved equipment and staffing invoices, and decided when to hire, buy or repair tournament kit
Main tournament-level contact for FACEIT, ESIC and BLAST Premier teams
Arranged venues and equipment for team bootcamps
Designated Safeguarding Lead and first aider at live events
